title: 2026-00065 — Order Approving MPD Exhibit A 2027.pdf
text:
STATE OF MAINE 
PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 

Docket No. 2026-00065 

July 9, 2026 

MAINE PUBLIC UTILITIES COMMISSION 
STANDARD OFFER BIDDING PROCESS 
PERTAINING TO CENTRAL MAINE 
POWER COMPANY AND VERSANT 
POWER 

ORDER APPROVING 
VERSANT POWER MAINE 
PUBLIC DISTRICT 
STANDARD OFFER 
UNCOLLECTABLE ADDER 

BARTLETT, Chair; SCULLY and GILBERT, Commissioners 

Versant Power filed a proposed contract Exhibit A for the Maine Public District 
(MPD) on July 7, 2026, including its proposed adder1 for the uncollectible accounts 
associated with Standard Offer Service in MPD for the residential/small non-
residential customer class for the calendar year 2027 term. 

Pursuant to the Delegation Order issued in Standard Offer Bidding Procedure, 
Docket No. 2004-00314 (May 18, 2004), I approve the contract Exhibit A for Versant 
Power’s MPD residential/small non-residential SOS customer class as filed by 
Versant on July 7th, 2026. 

Dated at Hallowell, Maine, this 9th day of July 2026. 

BY ORDER OF THE DIRECTOR OF ELECTRICITY AND GAS UTILITY INDUSTRIES 

_______________________________ 
Sally Zeh 

1 The methodology for recalculating the uncollectible adder is consistent with the 
approach described in the stipulation approved on September 12, 2025, in Docket No. 
2024-00248, and is consistent with the methodology that Versant used to calculate the 
adder for the Bangor Hydro District residential/small non-residential class.
